compound dala-mūla in locative plural indicating locations at petal bases
qualifies the petal bases as the second set
compound aṣṭa-dala describing the lotus support

items.question: In which locations on the eight-petaled lotus are the limbs to be worshipped?
premises: The ritual context includes an eight-petaled lotus.
The lotus contains a second set of petal bases.
The limbs are designated objects of worship.
items.inference: Therefore the limbs are to be worshipped in the bases of the second petals on the eight-petaled lotus.
uncertainties: Whether dvitīyeṣu refers to a second ring of petals or a second set of bases is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: One should worship the limbs in the bases of the second petals on the eight-petaled lotus.
